s: AWS, GCP, Azure — core services every backend dev needs
d: Most production systems run on cloud platforms. You don't need to know everything, but understanding compute (EC2/Cloud Run), storage (S3/GCS), databases (RDS/Cloud SQL), and networking (VPC, IAM) is essential for any backend role.
c: AWS core: EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, SQS, IAM, VPC
GCP core: Cloud Run, GCS, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub
Azure core: App Service, Blob Storage, Cosmos DB

p: Cloud is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
